verdict.rationale: Jira docs mention Rovo AI-powered custom automations including 'automated reminders to rules that move work forward' (jira-docs-4), implying some rule-based/recurring automation capability, but there is no concrete documentation of scheduling recurring jobs, cron-like triggers, or AI-native/API access to configure them. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of recurring/scheduled automation triggers, API or MCP-server support for programmatically creating/managing scheduled workflows, and independent confirmation of this capability working reliably.
